summary: Verified fix for Settings > Tag Khusus tab crash ('TypeError: destroy is not a function'). Logged in as owner, navigated to /pengaturan, clicked tab-tags. No error overlay, no console errors. Rapid tab switching (tab-wa/tab-tags/tab-pdf/tab-tags/tab-norm/tab-tags) produced 0 console errors. Add tag flow works with 'Tag ditambah' toast. Edit tag flow triggers 'Tag diperbarui' toast. All other Pengaturan tabs (tab-norm, tab-wa, tab-pdf, tab-csv, tab-users) render without errors. Delete flow could not be fully automated because the trash-icon delete button lacks a data-testid.
action_items: Minor testability improvement: Add data-testid (e.g., tag-del-{id}) to the trash-icon delete button in TagsPanel rows. Current icon-only button with no aria-label or testid makes automated deletion testing brittle. Currently only tag-name, tag-color, tag-add, tab-tags, and row Simpan buttons are targetable.
Optional: Add data-testid on row 'Simpan' buttons (e.g., tag-save-{id}) and on the row name input (e.g., tag-name-{id}) for more precise per-row targeting.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct and idiomatic: wrapping the async call in a block-body arrow so useEffect callback returns undefined instead of a Promise avoids React's cleanup-invocation error. Good minimal patch.

Consider extracting the tag-loading effect into a small custom hook (useTags) to prevent this class of bug recurring in similar panels (Normalisasi, Users, etc.). Skim of Pengaturan.jsx suggests other panels use similar arrow patterns — worth an audit.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tag-crash fix; 5/6 tasks fully automated (delete task blocked by missing testid, not by app bug)

seed_data_creation: Created and left one 'QA Test Tag' in the DB during first pass; also observed the 'VIP' tag may have been inadvertently removed during the automated edit/delete sweep of the earlier run (delete button icon-only, may have been reached via keyboard focus). Suggest reseeding tags for a clean demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Original bug (destroy is not a function on tab-tags click) is confirmed fixed. If you need to test the tag delete flow, note that the delete button currently has NO data-testid — it is an icon-only button. Use a selector like page.query_selector_all("button:has(svg)") within each tag row, or ask main agent to add data-testid=tag-del-{id}. Also, during automation the seed tag 'VIP' was accidentally deleted; may want to reseed.
rca of the issue: In TagsPanel (Pengaturan.jsx), `const load = () => api.get('/tags').then(r => setTags(r.data))` returned a Promise because of implicit-return arrow syntax. Passing it directly to `useEffect(load, [])` made React store the Promise as the effect's cleanup function; on unmount React tried to call `destroy()` (the Promise), throwing 'destroy is not a function'. Fix: use a block-body arrow `const load = () => { api.get('/tags').then(...); }` so `load` returns undefined. Verified end-to-end — no such error reproduces after fix.
